nom: Dermalogica Clear Start Breakout Clearing Booster

I've been using this product regularly. It's not over drying on my skin and helps clear blemishes.

This is a well thought out product from the texture of the lotion to the simplicity of the dispenser. My busy teens find this the easiest salicylic acid formula to use in the morning routine. They both have *very* sensitive skin (dermatographic urticaria for those that know the term) and both use this formula with great success! Keeps their moderate acne in check.

I am not one to write reviews, but I recently ran out of this and figured I'd use my old Mario Badescu drying lotion for some new break out spots I had. The next day I immediately reordered this clearing booster for pick up and it worked it's miracle. It truly clears up my acne and doesn't dry me out. I will make sure I never run out again.

Tried the tester on a whim because of a breakout that wouldnt go away. When I tell you the spots went away within a few hours I am not exaggerating. Use this for all my break outs for the past month or two and it's still awesome! Wish I found this sooner😭

I get hormonal acne especially during and before my period . And every tome i use this product it has either made my pimple (ready to pop or not ready to pop ) disapear or my pimple would be extremely small where by the second day the pimple is gone .i understand everyone has dofferent skin and experiences but this has worked for me for the last 3 years now i always order more right when i run out . It last me 6-7 months each time i buy . A little goes along way .

I have used this product each time my skin gets bad i have sensitive skin and cystic hormonal acne and each time this product saves my skin within a month my go to for sure now going to be in my normal routine

I use this everyday and after the peel, it's drying my pimple and it's slowly goes away when i sleep or wash my face. Also, it's absorb super quick!
This is second time I purchased this for my teenage son. This is his favorite and will be buying again.

Honestly I was very skeptical since I had already been breaking out for months and had tried everything. This helped clear my acne and it only took the travel size portion for me to buy the bigger size. I love it!

I just started using this and at first my skin was purging for the first two weeks and now it's starting to clear up more, I've even noticed it's brightening up my skin too. I will def continue to order this product. I also use this with the skin smoothing cream and the oil free matte spf moisturizer and it's been a great combo.
If i have a breakout I immediately treat my face with this and it works overnight you must try this is you have acne there is something in the ingredients that immediately stops the breakout somehow

So good. It really will clear your pimple(s) overnight. I've been using it multiple times a day on any pimples I get and they are always gone the next day. The only thing is sometimes it kinda turns into a "scab" if you overuse it and then it looks weird under make up but I havent had to worry about this since I've been make up free for a while. I love the bottle. The button to dispense was a genius idea but you have to be gentle. This product is a life saver, I make sure I always have it in my purse anywhere I go. Definitely going to repurchase.

Most of my breakouts occur along my jaw line. So hormonal acne. Usually it would flare up and then get better. I thought this product would help my acne during those flareups but ever since i started using it I have had huge painful pimples and new ones are constantly forming. My jawline is ten times worst. It may work for some but definitely not for me. I used the product consistently for 3 weeks and every morning i wake up wanting to cry because of how terrible my skin has gotten. Buyer Beware.

I have PCOS so my acne is constant, severe, and obnoxious. This helped start clearing it up in one use. Ive used it twice a day since I got it on Friday and I am OBSESSED. My face is clearer, the breakouts that do make it through are smaller. This is amazing.

Got this product from ULTA after the break out control was discontinued. The break out control worked great for my skin. This made my skin so bad that now all of the hard work I have done to clear my skin has gone down the drain.
Very light weight to put on skin. A great acne treatment and good skin stuff for your body
Have been using this for a couple of months, it does wonders. I personally like to apply at night time right before bed.

This product has helped tremendously with my son's teenage acne. It has served as a preventative for new breakouts.
I've had a few spot treatments before but none like this. This will clear my hormonal breakouts within one to two uses.

avis.titre: Highly effective - great for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I purchased the travel dermalogica acve treatment kit to test product on my hormonal, sensitive - reactive rosacea skin. First round of use I couldn't tell if it really worked - but ordered a full dize bottle to test further. My next cycle I applied nightly to breakout spots - within 2 days the spots are gone completely. No dryness, redness, or scabs at all. In comparison to ysing Mario B's buffering solution- this prodict is a dream… no burning, dryness, or scanning. Also healing time was 1/2 - 1/3 less overall- including redness. Also, the bottle is nice, and dispensing is easy / controllable through varying amount of pressure on the underside of the bottle. I have noticed less product waste with this method- and hope other companies follow suit.
Both my daughter and I love this product. It really works well.
I am not sure whether it works or not, as my teenager uses it in conjunction with other products but it hasn't given her more breakouts than usual.

I received the sample size of this then opted to buy a full size. I've had it for months without finishing it as I didn't have significant results. I much prefer the breakout booster facewash on its own.
So far I have not seen a major change using this product as a spot treatment. I will continue to use and update

I bought this product back in october to give it a yry after I was frustrated with little bumps and acne on my face. I have now been using this serum for 7 months, and there is still a lot of product left. I am extremely satisfied with how this serum works as I barely get break outs anymore and it helps clear out my skin. I usually use it in pm.

I get acne frequently and this really did help get rid of it. The second i would notice a red bump start to appear i would put this on it and the first day it would keep it from getting worse. The next day it would almost be gone, and by the 3rd or 4th day it would be completely gone, so consistency is key. Now i apply it to the spots on my face that tend to flare up and it helps prevent breakouts well! I apply it and let it set a few minutes before applying serums/moisturizers.

avis.titre: Acceptable substitute for overnight clearing gel
avis.texte: Acceptable substitute for the discontinued overnight clearing gel. Product produces similar results. Consistency is on the runny side which makes application somewhat difficult. I use in conjunction with post-breakout fix for problem areas.
So glad this product is available again! It was my favorite spot treatment.

I didn't love this product as I had hoped. I used as directed for one month, but like all skincare, I'm sure I would see more results with continued use. It didn't dry my skin out which was nice, but really didn't seem to help a lot with skin tone, and preventing new blemishes. I don't like the push button on the bottom. It's just awkward for me. Not something I would purchase again.

This helped my acne in just a few days! I went into Ulta for a quick facial because of a huge pimple I had. The esthetician recommended that since she used it after my facial. I absolutely loved it & it cleared it right away.
Amazing makes my breakout go away overnight! The results are fantastic even when only using a pea size amount. It helps remove my acne and acne scars
